coverage: Whole once, then source half a once and half b once, all rotated 180 degrees to read. The halves were read in that required order (a is the lower upright part; b is the upper). Covered manuscript and archive numbers; opening paragraph and marginal oval; both local opening deletions; abandoned display; all five numbered displays; all symbols, indices and punctuation; interchange curves; section heading and its call; all underlined prose; De plus, its canceled cursive underprint and call; donc and its call; all final tails and bottom continuation; the long full-page cancellation paths and all otherwise blank margins. No part remains unviewed. H is description only and supplies no textual collation rows.

changes.locus: Entire cancelled draft: long pencil paths over all text
changes.c: % The entire draft is cancelled by long diagonal strokes.
changes.evidence: Whole and both halves: several long descending, ascending and curved strokes cross the entire typescript, with a near-vertical left stroke. They are reproduced over the complete text, not replaced by horizontal paragraph strikes.

changes.locus: Left margin alongside the two composition laws
changes.evidence: Half b and crop 02: the sign is in the left margin inside a tall tilted pencil oval; C uses the default right margin and a circular border. The retained psi/Psi doubt is unchanged.
Crop 03: a u-shaped cup has a separate long oblique central shaft extending both above and below it. The shaft passes through the cup rather than merely prolonging its left side; read psi.
changes.mathematical_consequence: Names the second law psi; the formula structure is preserved.

changes.evidence: Crop 04 separates the dotted j with a lower hook and the following open parenthesis from the overtyped x cancellations.

changes.locus: Abandoned formula: separator after first g phi(x,y)
changes.evidence: Crop 05 shows a low comma tail after the first right parenthesis, below the row of cancelling x marks.

changes.locus: Abandoned formula: separator before terminal phi(
changes.evidence: Crop 05 shows a second low comma between the second g phi(x,y) and the terminal phi(. C omits this comma. The terminal expression remains unfinished.

changes.locus: Prose after (2.1.1.1): en followed by law symbol
changes.evidence: Half b: this occurrence was checked locally; the pen shaft traverses the u-shaped cup centrally and projects above and below it, as psi.
changes.mathematical_consequence: The named second law is psi; no algebraic claim is changed.

changes.evidence: Crop 06: the first slot has a c-shaped outer contour and an s-like central turn/lower bowl simultaneously. This is overlapping ink, not a choice between two clean single letters. Strike order cannot be established.

changes.locus: Two curved strokes beside and around (2.1.1.2)
changes.evidence: Crop 07: one line slopes from below-left of the label to a short upright at its right; another starts beside the label, bends left of the first phi, and continues beneath the first inner pair to a short downward terminal. Neither has an arrowhead.

changes.locus: (2.1.1.2): all three occurrences of the second law
changes.evidence: Crop 07: each of the three signs was inspected separately. Each has a u-shaped cup crossed by a long central sloping stem, distinguishing psi from a mu whose descending stem is at the left. Phi loops, parentheses, commas, x/y/z/t and equality are all separately visible.
changes.mathematical_consequence: The second law is consistently named psi; no argument, index or operator arrangement is repaired.

changes.locus: 2.2 opening: doubled E followed by cancelled glyph
changes.evidence: Crop 08: the first E has displaced repeated E contours and remains mathbb E. The next cancelled character has a tall t stem, crossbar and curved lower terminal; no three-bar E contour is established there.
Half a: a distinct typed comma sits immediately after E and before considéré.

changes.locus: En particulier paragraph: initial of Groupe/groupe
changes.evidence: Crop 09 shows both a full-height G with inward bar and a lowercase g with a descending lower loop, superposed in one slot. The two components are secure; their chronological order is not.

changes.locus: Interlinear cancellation immediately below added De plus,
changes.evidence: Crop 10: beneath the clearly typewritten De plus, there are cursive strokes crossed by a blue horizontal cancellation, above the curved insertion leader. No complete word can be recovered securely. Estimated one word; not treated as underline alone.
Crop 10: a high capital-C arch and terminal coexist with the lower c contour. Both cases are present in an overprint; their order is not established. The source underline remains.

changes.locus: Before P times Q after the common unit section
changes.evidence: Half a: a separate short horizontal line is visibly below de. It does not continue beneath the adjacent product expressions.

Crop 11: after the lower E, the cancelled slash is followed by an S-shaped upper curve and lower bowl. The visible curved right edge is not the straight stem/bowl combination of P or the closed loop/tail of Q.
changes.mathematical_consequence: The cancelled denominator reads S; no meaning or prior revision order is inferred.

changes.evidence: Crop 12: et une conséquence is readable under the x row, including the acute above the e of conséquence. A low comma tail precedes et and is itself in the cancelled span; C omits it.

c_doubts.evidence: Crop 02 makes the three-pronged form clear, but the isolated handwritten sign supplies no stable baseline or case scale distinguishing psi from Psi. Oval placement is separately corrected.

c_doubts.locus: Both equalities in the abandoned unnumbered formula
c_doubts.evidence: Crop 05: each suspected equality slot is crossed by cancelling x marks and long horizontal cancellation. Equality remains the supported tentative reading, without pretending the two bars can be isolated securely at either slot.
Crop 05: a clear low comma tail survives after the first g phi(x,y).
Crop 06 establishes superposed c/s components but not strike order. Retains doubt at the corrected scope and preserves both layers.

c_doubts.locus: Section 2.2 doubled E and following cancellation
c_doubts.evidence: Crop 08 confirms repeated same-letter E contours in the first slot and a cancelled t-shaped next glyph. It supplies no basis for a different earlier letter under the doubled E.
Crop 09: full-height G and descending lowercase g are both present. Retain both correction orders.
Crop 11 supports slash and the upper/lower curves of S; the P and Q alternatives are not supported by the exposed contour.

Crop 11: blue hatching and the x overtype hide the middle glyph too extensively to distinguish S, P and Q securely. The inserted close parenthesis after E remains separately encoded; no earlier revision is reconstructed.
Crop 12 supports the letters and the acute of conséquence. It also reveals the preceding cancelled comma, newly included.

notes.text: Cancelled draft, manuscript page 19; the archive number is 26 in the opposite orientation. Sections 2.1.1 and 2.2 run through equation (2.2.3), and the final sentence continues with on note. No date or total page count is visible.
notes.basis: Observation: top number, archive-number crop 01, headings, display labels and bottom continuation.

notes.text: The page describes a biextension structure by two partly defined laws, states their equivariance and interchange relation, then introduces the two unit sections and their common neutral section. This is a description of the page, not a proof check.

The second-law signs have a cup traversed centrally by a long oblique shaft; psi is read at the opening, in the following prose, and independently at all three interchange-formula positions. The isolated marginal psi/Psi remains uncertain as to case.
notes.basis: Observation: half b and crops 02, 03, 07. No published text or mathematical reconstruction used.

notes.text: The source pairs the trivialization over 1_P times Q with e_E/P, and that over P times 1_Q with e_E/Q. These source indices are retained exactly; they have not been interchanged to match a presumed interpretation.
notes.basis: Observation: half a, underlined torseur paragraph. Mathematical context served only to prompt a local reading check; no proof was performed.

notes.text: The overprints c/s, G/g and C/c retain both correction orders. Doubled E is separately represented as mathbb E under the supplied typewriter convention. The cancelled final Gamma denominator remains /S), /P) or /Q); no earlier draft is reconstructed.
notes.basis: Observation: crops 06, 08–11; this distinguishes visible components from unknown strike chronology.

notes.text: The interlinear source has typewritten De plus, above a cancelled cursive word and a curved insertion call. The cursive remains illegible after the single tight enlarged crop. It is an omission in C and is explicitly retained as one estimated unreadable word.
notes.basis: Observation: crop 10; the illegibility is limited to prose, not a mathematical symbol.

notes.text: No mathematical checking occurred in this reader run; check_events is intentionally empty. The full reading and inventory cover the entire page, including source graphics and margins.
notes.basis: Scope of this independent diplomatic reading.
